achievements.name: First Partner
achievements.detail: Choose Turtwig, Chimchar, or Piplup as your first partner.

achievements.name: First Catch
achievements.detail: Catch a wild Pokémon so the Sinnoh Pokédex records it.

achievements.name: Coal Badge
achievements.detail: Defeat Roark in Oreburgh Gym and earn the Coal Badge.

achievements.name: Eight Badges
achievements.detail: Beat all eight Sinnoh Gym Leaders and collect every Gym Badge.

achievements.name: Hideaway Catch
achievements.detail: Enter the Grand Underground and catch a Pokémon in a Hideaway.

achievements.name: Contest Show
achievements.detail: Win a Super Contest Show category in Hearthome City.

achievements.name: Team Galactic
achievements.detail: Defeat the Team Galactic commanders who confront you across Sinnoh.

achievements.name: Dialga
achievements.detail: Catch Dialga, the legendary Pokémon of this version, at Spear Pillar.

achievements.name: Hall of Fame
achievements.detail: Defeat the Elite Four and Champion Cynthia, then record your team in the Hall of Fame.

achievements.name: Sinnoh Pokédex
achievements.detail: Encounter every Pokémon listed in the Sinnoh Pokédex.

achievements.name: National Pokédex
achievements.detail: After seeing the Sinnoh Pokédex through, receive the National Pokédex from Professor Rowan.

achievements.name: Battle Tower
achievements.detail: Win 100 battles in a row in the Battle Tower.
